The '''[[1936 in association football|1936]]–[[1937 in association football|37]] season''' was the 45th season of [[The Football League]]. Manchester City became champions of England for the first time, whilst [[Charlton Athletic F.C.|Charlton Athletic]] achieved their highest-ever league placing, finishing second in their first season in the top flight.
